title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees in all axes and a translation vector of [0.0, 0.0, 0.375]. For the first face, draw two loops. In the first loop, start by drawing a line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.0294, 0.0), then from (0.0294, 0.0) to (0.0294, 0.0294), followed by (0.0294, 0.0294) to (0.0, 0.0294), and finally back to the origin. For the second loop, draw a line from (0.0028, 0.0028) to (0.0265, 0.0028), then from (0.0265, 0.0028) to (0.0265, 0.0265), followed by (0.0265, 0.0265) to (0.0028, 0.0265), and back to (0.0028, 0.0028). Scale the entire 2D sketch by a factor of 0.0294. Rotate the 2D sketch using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translate it using the vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.375]. Extrude the 2D sketch 0.1875 units along the normal direction and another 0.1875 units in the opposite direction, ensuring the sketch is scaled by 0.0294 before extrusion. This will create a new solid body with a final length of 0.029393173198482933, width of 0.029393173198482933, and height of 0.375.

# Import necessary CAD-Query modules
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.0294, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.0294, 0.0294)
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0294)
    .close()
    .faces()
    .moveTo(0.0028, 0.0028)
    .lineTo(0.0265, 0.0028)
    .lineTo(0.0265, 0.0265)
    .lineTo(0.0028, 0.0265)
    .close()
)

# Extrude the sketch
extruded = sketch.extrude(0.1875, both=True)

# Apply the translation vector
final_model = extruded.translate((0.0, 0.0, 0.375))

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = final_model

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.0294, 0).lineTo(0.0294, 0.0294).lineTo(0, 0.0294).close()

# Define the inner loop
inner_loop = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.0024, 0.0024).lineTo(0.027, 0.0024).lineTo(0.027, 0.027).lineTo(0.0024, 0.027).close()

# Perform the extrusion
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.1875, both=True)

# Perform the cut operation
cut = extrusion.cut(inner_loop.extrude(0.1875, both=True))

# Translate the final model
r = cut.translate((0, 0, 0.375))
